name: GoPro Hero 13 Black
whySpecs: Shoots 5.3K60, 4K120 and 2.7K240. GoPro requires V30 or UHS-3 cards. V30 guarantees 30 MB/s of sustained write, about double the Hero 13's 120 Mbps High bitrate, so the card does not fall behind mid-clip. GoPro supports cards up to 1TB.

faq.q: Can I use a full-size SD card in the GoPro Hero 13?
faq.a: No, the Hero 13 only takes microSD cards.

faq.q: Do I need a V60 or UHS-II card for the Hero 13?
faq.a: No. V30 covers every recording mode. The slot is UHS-I, so a UHS-II card records at UHS-I speed and only offloads faster in a UHS-II reader.

faq.q: Does the GoPro Hero 13 support a 1TB microSD card?
faq.a: Yes, GoPro supports cards up to 1TB on the Hero 13. A 1TB card saves swaps on all-day shoots. Two 512GB cards are safer, because one failed card then loses half your footage instead of all of it.

faq.q: How often should I replace my GoPro SD card?
faq.a: Replace it at the first error message, corrupted file or failed write. Format it in the camera, not on a computer, each time you offload.

notes: Card requirements match Hero 12. Official GoPro guidance: A2/V30, up to 1TB.
metaDescription: The GoPro Hero 13 Black needs a V30 or UHS-3 microSD card, up to 1TB. V30 doubles the 120 Mbps High bitrate for 5.3K60 and 4K120. Best cards.

faq.q: Is it called the Insta360 ONE X3?
